scope: Defects found by AUTOMATION during this mission. Real-user feedback is tracked separately in PRIVATE_ALPHA_FEEDBACK_LOG.json.

defects.title: Expired session dead-ended the platform with no route back to sign-in
defects.root_cause: app/platform/page.jsx surfaced SESSION_INVALID through setError but never cleared the dead token. The sign-in form renders only under !token, so an idle-expired session (idle_ttl_sec 3600) left the owner stuck behind a raw error.
defects.user_impact: After one hour idle, the owner could not sign in again without manually clearing localStorage.
defects.resolution: Authenticated SESSION_INVALID / MEMBERSHIP_REVOKED / 401 now clear the token via the canonical helper, blank every authenticated field, and restore the sign-in surface. 403, 5xx, offline and malformed responses deliberately do not clear.
defects.evidence: commit 6b55013; 11 regression tests in lib/platform-ops.test.js; browser-verified with a synthetic dead token (auto-cleared, sign-in rendered, 0 uncaught errors, 1 navigation entry, /me called once)

defects.title: Running Next.js server serves a stale manifest after .next is rebuilt
defects.root_cause: next start holds the build manifest in memory. Rebuilding .next underneath a running server makes it serve HTML referencing chunk hashes that no longer exist, producing ChunkLoadError and a blank 'SaathiOS failed to load' screen despite HTTP 200.
defects.user_impact: Application appears completely broken while the server reports healthy. Encountered twice in this session.
defects.resolution: Operationally resolved by restarting the server after each build. NOT fixed in code.
defects.recommendation: Add a build-id check or a documented 'rebuild then restart' step to the local run guide, so a rebuild can never leave a healthy-looking but broken server.

defects.title: Two auth systems present contradictory first-run state
defects.root_cause: /api/v1/auth/passkey/status reports has_password=false and /unlock therefore renders 'Set up sign-in', while the platform account system already holds password hashes for all three users. The two systems are independent.
defects.user_impact: A returning owner whose session expired can be shown a first-time 'set a password' screen, which reads as data loss.

defects.title: Expired-session recovery offers 'Bootstrap + login' as the only control
defects.root_cause: The unauthenticated /platform surface presents a single button that both creates an org/workspace/owner and logs in. There is no distinct 'sign in' affordance for a returning user.
defects.user_impact: A returning user is invited to run a first-installation action. Wording implies setup rather than re-authentication.
defects.note: Discovered while verifying PA-D-001. The recovery path now works; the label on the destination is what remains confusing.

defects.title: ollama binds all interfaces on *:11434
defects.root_cause: Third-party local model server, not SaathiOS code. Every SaathiOS listener (3000, 8765, 8766) is correctly bound to 127.0.0.1.
defects.user_impact: On an untrusted network, a local model endpoint is reachable from other hosts. Does not expose SaathiOS data or authority, but it is real machine exposure alongside a local-first product.
defects.recommendation: Set OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1 so the offline-first posture holds for the whole stack. Owner decision - outside the SaathiOS repository.

defects.title: Breadcrumb truncates to 'Pla...' at the observed viewport

release_gate_evaluation.gate: No P0 or P1 defect is open. The release gate is NOT blocked by automation-found defects.
release_gate_evaluation.caveat: This evaluation covers automation-found defects only. Real-user validation has not run, so unknown P0/P1 defects may exist in the authenticated journeys that were never exercised.
